pdb_path.description: Absolute path to the input PDB whose backbone is held fixed while ProteinMPNN samples sequences.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream backbone-design tool (e.g. RFdiffusion). Promotes the first item's structure_path into `pdb_path` when omitted.

profile_guidance.description: Family-profile guidance compiled from a profile_source upstream. When the designed chain length matches the profile consensus length, ProteinMPNN applies a soft position-specific amino-acid bias.

chains.description: Chain identifiers to design. Null designs every chain in the structure (typical for de novo monomer or binder design).

num_designs.description: Number of sequences sampled per input structure.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. 0.1 (default) gives high-confidence sequences near the model argmax; raise toward 0.3-0.5 for diversity.

omit_aas.description: Amino-acid one-letter codes to forbid at every position. Default `X` blocks the unknown token; concatenate letters with no separator.

seed.description: Optional RNG seed for reproducibility. Null lets the model choose its own seed.
